verifications.claim: PlayStation Plus is a subscription service for PlayStation consoles.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Pick from three membership options to get the games and benefits you need." (R1); "PlayStation Plus at a glance" (R3); "Pick your plan with PlayStation®Plus. Discover 3 new membership plans." (R4); "PlayStation's long-running subscription service, PlayStation Plus" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly describe PlayStation Plus as a subscription service with membership plans for PlayStation consoles.

verifications.claim: Essential, Extra, and Premium.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Essential, Extra, Premium sections throughout (R1, R3); "$9.99 ... ESSENTIAL ... $14.99 ... EXTRA ... $17.99 ... Includes everything in EXTRA +" (R4); "PS Plus Essential ... PS Plus Extra ... PS Plus Premium" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: All major sources list the three tiers as Essential, Extra, and Premium.

verifications.claim: PlayStation Plus Essential tier is priced at $9.99/mo, $24.99/3 mo, $79.99/yr in USD.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: $9.99 1 month ... 3 months $24.99 ... 12 months $79.99" under Essential (R4); "PlayStation Plus Essential - $9.99/month" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: R4 matches exact prices including 3-month and annual; R5 confirms monthly price.

verifications.claim: PlayStation Plus Essential tier includes online multiplayer.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Online Multiplayer" listed under Essential (R1, R3); "Online Multiplayer" (R4); "Online Multiplayer" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Directly listed as a benefit for Essential tier across sources.

verifications.claim: PlayStation Plus Essential tier includes two or three monthly games.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "Monthly Games*" under Essential (R1, R3); "Monthly Games - anywhere from three to four games" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm monthly games for Essential, but specify varying numbers (3-4 in R5) rather than exactly 'two or three'; broader support but less precise.

verifications.claim: PlayStation Plus Essential tier includes exclusive discounts.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Exclusive Discounts" under Essential (R1, R3, R4); "Exclusive Discounts" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Directly listed as a benefit.

verifications.claim: PlayStation Plus Essential tier includes cloud storage.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Cloud Storage" under Essential (R1, R3, R4); "Cloud Storage" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Directly listed as a benefit.

verifications.claim: PlayStation Plus Extra tier is priced at $14.99/mo, $39.99/3 mo, $134.99/yr in USD.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: $14.99 1 month ... 3 months $39.99 ... 12 months $134.99" under Extra (R4); "PS Plus Extra - $14.99/month" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: R4 matches exact prices; R5 confirms monthly.

verifications.claim: PlayStation Plus Extra tier includes all Essential benefits.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Get all the great benefits included in the PlayStation Plus Essential plan" (R1, R3); "Includes everything in ESSENTIAL" (R4); "Everything that comes with PS Plus Essential" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly stated.

verifications.claim: PlayStation Plus Extra tier includes a catalog of up to 400+ downloadable PS4 and PS5 games.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "Game Catalog, featuring hundreds of games ... PS4 and PS5" (R1, R3); "Game Catalog Hundreds of incredible games" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Game Catalog with hundreds of PS4/PS5 games for Extra; '400+' is more specific but aligns with 'hundreds'.

verifications.claim: PlayStation Plus Premium/Deluxe tier is priced at $17.99/mo, $49.99/3 mo, $159.99/yr in USD.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: $17.99 1 month ... 3 months $49.99 ... 12 months $159.99" under Premium (R4); "PS Plus Premium - $17.99/month" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Exact match in R4; R5 confirms monthly. Sources use Premium/Deluxe interchangeably.

verifications.claim: PlayStation Plus Premium/Deluxe tier includes all Extra benefits.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Enjoy all the core PlayStation Plus benefits, hundreds of games in the Game Catalog" implying Extra (R1, R3); "Includes everything in EXTRA" (R4); "Everything that comes with ... Extra" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly includes lower tier benefits.

verifications.claim: PlayStation Plus Premium/Deluxe tier includes a Classics Catalog (PS1, PS2, PS3, PSP).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Classics Catalog" under Premium (R1, R3); "Classics Catalog - a catalog of PS1, PS2, PS3, PSP" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Directly listed with exact platforms.

verifications.claim: PlayStation Plus Premium/Deluxe tier includes game trials.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Game Trials" under Premium (R1, R3); "Game Trials" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Directly listed.

verifications.claim: PlayStation Plus Premium/Deluxe tier includes cloud streaming for select games.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Cloud Streaming" under Premium (R1, R3); "Cloud Streaming - the ability to stream ... select games" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Directly listed for select games.

verifications.claim: PlayStation Plus users can add new games to their library each month.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "add new games to your collection every month" (R3); "You can add the monthly games to your game library" (R1); "add to your library each month" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly described for monthly games.

verifications.claim: PlayStation Plus game catalog includes Ubisoft+ Classics.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Ubisoft+ Classics" under Extra/Premium Game Catalog (R1, R3); "Ubisoft+ Classics - a library of classic Ubisoft titles" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Directly listed as part of Game Catalog.

verifications.claim: PlayStation Plus Premium allows streaming games directly to a PS5 or PC.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Cloud streaming ... to their PS4 or PS5 console or to a PC" (R1); "Cloud Streaming ... to a PS5 or PC" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly states streaming to PS5 and PC.

verifications.claim: PlayStation Plus members have access to members-only deals, discounts, and in-game items.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Exclusive Discounts ... Exclusive Content" (R1, R3); "Exclusive Discounts ... Exclusive Content" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Directly matches deals/discounts (exclusive discounts) and in-game items (exclusive content).

verifications.claim: Effective January 2026, Sony has shifted focus toward offering more PS5 games as part of the monthly benefits, reducing the frequency of PS4 game offerings.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "*From January 2026, PS4 games will be added only intermittently." under Monthly Games and Game Catalog (R1, R3)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm reduced PS4 frequency from Jan 2026, implying PS5 focus, but do not explicitly state 'shifted focus toward more PS5 games' or limit strictly to 'monthly benefits'; broader but supportive.
